note: Export activity is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated customs/B-L records exist (B/L 1112736, 2026-02-28, DADRI ICD INDER6 -> Berbera, Somalia) with HS 87089900 and 87089300. HS note per project rule: declared HS 870850 (drive axles / non-driving axles and parts) does not match the observed codes 87089900 (other parts/accessories of motor vehicles) and 87089300 (clutch parts) — HS should be corrected to the factual codes; this is not a rejection ground. Role: appears to be a trader/distributor of auto parts (buys from Taiwan/China suppliers such as CHU HUNG OIL SEALS, SHUANGHUAN PISTON RING, CIXI SIEE AUTO PARTS and resells to Nepal/Somalia/Uganda buyers) — role classification manufacturer/trader is outside my scope, but the shipment pattern is consistent with trader. The 'KHANEJA MOTORS PVT LTD' slug returned an empty record set, so the legal form is unconfirmed; the entity with records is the unqualified 'KHANEJA MOTORS'. Revenue and export volume in value terms: null — ImportKey free view shows record counts only, no values. Domestic supply: no traces found in public sources; stated as unknown rather than assumed.
